observed.caption: A man in a suit signs an open book on a wooden desk while five people stand around watching indoors.
observed.description: In an indoor room with a speckled stone wall, six people gather around a dark wooden desk in front of a white backdrop banner. One man in a dark suit and patterned tie is seated at the center leaning over an open book and writing with a pen, with eyeglasses and a white case beside him on the desk. Five other people stand behind and beside the desk observing, including a woman in a bright yellow, orange and black patterned jacket, two men in dark suits with ties, a partially cropped man at the far left edge, and a person in a blue military uniform with a peaked cap and gold braided cord. Two tall clear glass vases with floral arrangements sit on opposite ends of the desk, one with pink and white lilies on the left and one with white and yellow flowers on the right. A framed painting hangs on the wall to the right of the banner.
